headings.instructions: Use Outfit for all H1-H4 headings. Keep font sizes fluid but bounded (max text-5xl for hero).

body.instructions: Use Manrope for paragraphs, labels, and small text. Avoid Inter.

mono.instructions: Use for the final generated prompt text and any code/prompt blocks.

colors.description: High contrast neutral base (stark white / deep black) paired with a single, highly saturated accent color to represent AI generation.
colors.instructions: Update index.css variables to reflect a cleaner neutral palette. --primary should be the accent blue (hsl(221, 83%, 53%)). --background should be pure white in light mode, and very dark gray/black (hsl(220, 10%, 10%)) in dark mode. Avoid colored grays (slate/zinc) - prefer neutral grays.

layouts.global: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-12 for section paddings. Prevent text collision by padding inner containers.

landing_page.hero: Asymmetric layout. Text left, floating UI elements/images right. Clear CTA.
landing_page.features: Bento grid (TETRIS mode) for 'How it Works' and 'Features'. Varying card sizes, 1px borders.

app_wizard.structure: Split screen or Sidebar layout on desktop. Left side: Progress steps (Product -> Style -> Creator -> Generate) + Image Preview. Right side: Scrollable form/settings area.
app_wizard.form_elements: DO NOT use standard <select> dropdowns for settings (Hook style, Gender, etc.). Instead, use Bento-style selectable Chips or Cards (Grid of buttons) to feel like a modern SaaS.

result_page.structure: Two columns. Main column: Huge container for the generated Google Flow prompt with syntax highlighting/monospace font and large 'Copy' button. Right column: Stack of 'Quick-Regenerate' action buttons (Make it more viral, Less salesy, etc.).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat solid surfaces with subtle 1px borders (border-border). Avoid excessive glassmorphism except for sticky headers.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Keep it flat by default. Add subtle drop shadows (shadow-md) only on hover or for floating menus.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-xl for large containers/cards, rounded-lg for buttons and inputs.

components.buttons: Large (h-12 or h-14). Primary CTAs should use the strong accent color. Use pill-shaped (rounded-full) or standard rounded-lg. Add hover lifts (-translate-y-1).
components.cards: Minimalist, no heavy shadows. Use cardless sections where possible, relying on whitespace and 1px grid borders.
components.upload_zone: Massive drag-and-drop area for the product photo with dashed border and clear upload icon.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements (transition-transform, background-color shifts).
motion.step_transitions: Use framer-motion to slide in new wizard steps (opacity 0 to 1, y: 10 to 0) to avoid jarring page jumps.

media.instructions: Use standard HTML or React lucide icons. No 3D libraries needed for this clean SaaS MVP.

landing_hero.description: Creator recording video for Hero section mockup

app_product_mockup.description: Minimal skincare bottle for the 'Product' upload step

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets WCAG AA standards over backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, selectable cards, copy buttons) MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case describing their role (e.g., data-testid='upload-product-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup fonts (Outfit, Manrope, JetBrains Mono) in index.html.
2. Modify tailwind.config.js and index.css for the neutral + 1 accent color scheme.
3. Implement the Landing Page with the provided Unsplash images and bento grids.
4. Build the multi-step app in a dedicated route (e.g., /create) utilizing state for steps.
5. Do NOT use emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
6. Make the result page prompt copyable and use Sonner for the success toast.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts. Use left-aligned, robust grid structures.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical defaults.
Avoid the 'AI slop' look (no emojis, no generic dashboards, no heavy multi-color gradients).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep styling flat with crisp borders.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
Never use placehold.it or similar placeholder image services. Use only provided URLs.
